title: Address
description: A structured physical or postal location used to reach a person, household, or organization. Addresses combine spatial and administrative components such as street, settlement, district, and postal code.

full_address.description: The complete address written as a single text string. Coexists with structured address components for systems that store addresses as free text.

street_address.description: The street name, number, and any apartment or building identifiers.

house_number.description: The house, building, or plot number within a street or road.

building_name.description: The name of a building, estate, or compound, used in contexts where locations are identified by name rather than street number.

address_area.description: The name of a geographic area such as a neighborhood, quarter, or ward that groups addresses below the city level.

city.description: The city, town, or village component of the address.

administrative_area.description: The first-level administrative subdivision (province, state, region) containing the address.

postal_code.description: The postal or zip code of the address.

country.description: The country, expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code where possible.

location.description: The geographic location of the subject of this record, captured as coordinates or administrative area.
